rachel.m: Heads-up: seeing a weird handoff loop for a subset of HubSpot leads that then flip owners after SF sync. opening thread to capture a mitigation/playbook.

devon: pattern? mapping or enrichment?

rachel.m: sample flow: HS lead created -> assigned to RR owner X -> we sync to SF -> SF owner mapping fails (case mismatch on email) -> SF triggers reassign -> HS receives update and rotation re-evaluates -> owner flips.

tara: oh that explains some midday noise. SF mapping uses `Owner_Email__c` that expects lowercase; our sync kept original case, so SF couldn't find the owner and applied default queue owner.

sam: is enrichment involved or just mapping?
rachel.m: mostly mapping + webhook duplicates. enrichment often returns later and triggers another claim. two sources of churn: (1) casefold mismatch on SF owner lookup, (2) duplicate webhook events from HS + retries during busy windows.

ops-bot: telemetry: handoff-reassigns spike +0.9% when webhook_rate > 200/s; top cohort accounts: enterprise trial cohorts.

pablo: proposals: 1) canonicalize owner email to lowercase before SF upsert. 2) add idempotency_key to HS->our-api -> SF sync to dedupe retries. 3) add "sticky-hash" fallback: RR uses consistent-hash(lead.id) for 2 minutes after initial assign so subsequent inbound updates don't re-run full rotation.

devon: sticky-hash is interesting. effectively we treat the first owner assignment as affinity for N seconds unless explicit owner-change signal. reduces stomp.
tara: also add a quick validation step in the sync path: if SF owner lookup fails, do not assign default queue; instead route to human-review overflow-pool and tag lead with `owner-mapping-failed`. that prevents immediate flip.
sam: SLA discussion: current target is ack within 60s and handoff complete <5m. these changes keep median unchanged but should remove noisy flips from 99p. any impact on VIP leads? we should bypass sticky-hash for VIP/paid leads and preserve immediate sync behavior.
rachel.m: agree. I'll draft a short playbook for oncall: detection (reassign_count>2 within 3m), auto-mitigation (toggle sticky-hash on in config, lower webhook concurrency from 400->200 temporarily), and followup (create SF mapping ticket).

ops-bot: automation: created alert rule -> #support when reassign_count > 2 in 3m and source=hubspot.
pablo: test plan: unit for casefold_lookup, e2e staging sim with high webhook replay, and a 10% canary for 24h. add telemetry: owner_affinity_age histogram, mapping_fail_count.
devon: I'll PR code change for email normalizer + idempotency header. tara will change SF upsert flow to not default-assign on lookup miss. sam will update SLA doc to note sticky-affinity exception for VIPs.
rachel.m: ETA PRs by EOD, staging run tomorrow 9am PT, canary 10am if smoke looks good. tagging @sam @tara @pablo for followups.
tara: will add playbook notes with exact CLI commands to follow the alert and manual remediation steps.
rachel.m: thanks team, great catch. this should cut churn and improve inbound handoff metrics. :sparkles:
